我这个推荐，只为了献给这个机械世界中的一切……
很多人觉得，无法接受这个价格，觉得不值，觉得优化渣，觉得剧情短…对 是这样 在与许多大作的价格参考比对下，仅靠着最初对小姐姐屁股的向往来讲，是不值。
但是，如果你真的把这个游戏完完整整的玩过一遍，拿到所有成就，玩完所有支线，你会发现这里的绝望很美……你在任何一个场景下 场景bgm绝对都是无可挑剔的…
所谓绝望就是把美好的东西，毁给人看。如果你收集了所有的文本资料，认真想了每个支线任务之后，作者想说的话…如果你看到了故事发展的过程中，那种不知从何而来渗透溢出的绝望，你也许会得到这样一句话…
机械的世界里拥有了感情到底会成为一件多不幸的事情，也许你没有为这部游戏哭过，但至少，当三周目，这个世界里希望与你来到这个世界的初衷毁灭时 你的心里一定不好受。你开始想要拯救，拯救一个虚拟的游戏角色，你为了这个目的在无数次放弃的选择里选择继续下去，甚至最后为了这种拯救消去这个世界里你所存在过的证明。你这个人进到了你买的这部游戏里，拯救着你想要拯救的东西，你还能说这是部烂作品 你要给差评吗？
我给不了…给也是给se
简单描述一下缺点 过于无敌的闪避系统 略微弱智的芯片系统 流程还是短 因为我用70多小时就完美全收集结束了
最后几句话献给这个机械世界，我玩了尼尔的两部作品，我庆幸我来到这个世界，我不后悔用自己花费很多时间打出的存档去守护他们…
在我的心里，在这个世界里奋战的我，永远葬在开满月之泪的屋前
再见了2B A2 9S
再见了 这个因满是感情而不幸的机械世界
再见了 小姐姐

This game is hard to rate by 1 to 10 scale and just by "recommend" and "don't recommend" cause it is very peculiar. 

The game itself is a continuation of previously console exclusive Drakengard series and its "branch" Nier. This is a 3-rd person slasher with shooter, platformer and sometimes top-down elements, cause camera sometimes switched to different angles and we get "new experience".
  
The plot is twisted and told in quite unsual form. I think for you it would be enough to know that 8000 years passed since the last game and to get all story piece you have to complete the game 3 times (dont tell me thats a lot, for original Nier you had to replay it whole 25 times). Neverheless, each of every 3 playthroughs is a go with a new character and glance at the story from a different perspective. 

And not to linger with the review, cause most of modern gamers dont like to read more than 200 words in a review, I would say: if you like japanese games and their style, ready to spend 30-40 hours on all 3 playthroughs and you dont get irritated by this whole japanse culture - the game is for you. I, personally, have enjoyed and really loved it. 

P.S. The game is in english only, which can be a problem for foreign people but I think there will be at least unofficial translations at some point.

TL;DR: 

If you're looking for good story, music and combat - buy it. DISCLAIMER: only getting 5 endings is worth playing the game. If you want to give up after 1st one, don't buy NieR.

Don't forget to read negative reviews! most of them will mention quality of the port itself, not the content of the game.

First of all:
- Yes, the optimization sucks
- Yes, controls are a bit weird for first hour or so
- Yes, cutscenes and Steam overlay are locked at 1600x900
- Yes, there's no windowed fullscreen option
- Yes, cutscenes are in 30FPS
- Yes, port should be done WAY better

Having said that, I want to get to the GAME.

Checklist:

- Laughed a lot
- Seen dat ass
- Experienced strong eargasm each time the music got intense
- Had fun with great combat system
- Hoarded shit ton of items that I didn't use
- Cried several times, looking at the screen with blank mind and just staring at the menu for 10 minutes after the credits.
- Unlocked every ending just to find out each one is more depressing, inspiring and kinda happy (at the same time) than the previous one.

Overall, story is great, not 10/10 for first and second ending but 3rd and two more that you can unlock in ~30-40 minutes after 3rd are 24615784687,549 / 10.
Music - straight up best soundtrack ever.
Gameplay is great. Controls are responsive and combat system is not too easy, not too hard (unless you're going hardest mode, then just... get a life I guess).
World is small so you're getting used to it after a while and can navigate it without a minimap. Every gameplay feature is embeded into the world - minimap, sound options etc are part of the game, not just UI.

The best thing about this game is the "last" ending [E]. I can't tell anything without spoilers so... Believe me, it's worth it to get it. If you made it this far into my review then just buy the game.

Что же касается самой игры?
Лично мое мнение, что ее можно поставить рядом с последним MGS. Это настоящий шедевр.
Да, здесь не самая лучшая графика, здесь не очень хорошая оптимизация на ПК, здесь не такой живой открытый мир, как в GTA, здесь даже не двигаются губы у героев при разговоре, как в играх 2000 годов (это относится к самой игре, в роликах все "ок" с анимацией лиц), набор комбо, не такой большой как в DMC, неудобная карта, и, возможно, есть еще какие-то нюансы, которые могут не понравится... 

НО: неполный экран можно легко исправить установкой мода FAR https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SpecialK_Mods/discussions/3/1334600128973500691/  (спасибо автору мода за его труд), со временем к карте привыкаешь, а геймплей и сюжет затягивает настолько, что перестаешь обращать внимание на все огрехи игры и не замечаешь, как на улице становится светло и скоро нужно на работу.

Вот вспомните, сколько игр вы прошли не отрываясь несколько раз подряд?

Начну сразу, без каких-либо прелюдий.

Недостатки:
1. Графика. Она не плоха, но для игры 2017г это плохо. Но когда играешь, ты ее не замечаешь на фоне происходящего.
2. Оптимизация. Она ужасна, без модификаций это просто ужас. И сюда отнесу также проблему с разрешением, которя чинится тоже модами.
3. Управление. Не знаю как вам, но на клава-мыше я продержался половину пролога. Дальше только геймпад.
4. Гринд. Чесно, я устал от РПГ, а тут кроме ресурсов на улучшение оружия и чипы есть, которые увелчивают ХП, дмг, дают слоумод, и т.д.

Плюсы:
1. Сюжет. Он просто офигенен. Он красив, изумителен и т.д. и т.п.
2. Персонажи. Они проработаны. В течении игры они развиваются, кроме А2, ей и ее истории уделено мало внимания.
3. Геймплей. Здесь не много, но и не мало оружия и программ для пода. Но тут множество комбинаций, и боевка не надоедает. Убийства роботов может надоесть, но уже пройдет много времени, и игра будет пройдена с нуля множество раз.
4. Мир. Локации проработаны, да и сам мир не большой, но он и не маленький, ты не устаешь, перебегая с локации на локации, да и телепорт есть, если что.

ХЗ куда девать:
Камера, она не хороша и не плоха, вовремя ее смены може произойти казус, например, она может следовать от 3 лица в бункере, и вы увидите космос. Или во время босс-файта в парке развлечений, когда камера перемещаестся на верх, но она очень близко, и ты нихера не видишь.
Концовки. Чтоб получить все надо реально постараться. У меня нет 2ух, одна секретная, и получить ее тяжело, другую я запорол.

Оценка игре 9/10. минус бал за оптимизацию.

NieR:Automata

It is one of the best games which i played in my gaming history.
For me it should have at least a nomination for Game of the year, as it is just a fantastic and amazing game.

At first i wasn't really sure if i wanted to get it but after watching some videos and reading some stuff about it over internet, i decided to give it a go. 
And it was worth every hour i spend playing it!

Story is just brilliant, it is one of the best stories i ever played.
It does have 26 endings but only 5 count as main ones.

Ending A - wasn't expecting that all stuff at end
Ending and route  B - can get a bit boring at some point but it is needed to play it to understand story even better
Ending C -  one word to describe it, amazing
Ending D - that ending is also amazing and make you think a bit...
Ending E - it is just one of the best endings i ever saw in games in many years... and you will want more after it... also after this ending there is something which is raerly seen in games and i was a bit surprised about it, but i wont tell what you need to find it by yourself ;)

It is required to play through all of main endings to fully understand this game.
Main characters of it are really nicely done;
2B is a main character and i liked her the most because of her "character".
9S is just a poor little boy who got himself into something big.
A2 when she appeared in the game she sounded a little bit same as 2B and it was also nice to play as her.

Because of that characters you can get a bit emotional at some missions (like i did) because as i said you can really get close to them and it dosen't really happen to often in games...

Soundtrack is one of the best game music i ever heard, especially Weight of the World.

Gameplay in overall is great too, main quest wast at start a bit confusing but later when you made it through few first missions it was just getting better and better.

Side quests were pretty ok and it wasn't necessary to do them, yet they were interesting despite that they were almost all same.

I really liked crafting system even when it was a little bit frustrating at some times to collect enough materials to upgrade weapons.

There is enough weapons for everyone to fit their game style :)

Graphic isn't the best in it but everything else compensate it or at least it did for me.

Voice acting is pretty nice too, on first playthrough i played it with Japanese voice and english text and now i'm planning to play it again with English voices to see how they sound :)

If you are a emotional person you might be "touched" by few moments in this game as i was left almost in tears at some points of it...

I guess that's enough of my mumbling.

Yes i do recommend this game fantastic game, it is a GOTY material for me, and i  give it full 10/10.

I might not cover everything or not say everything i want but last thing i will say is that after playing this game i was left in a shock how good it was, and it did touch something inside of me...

So, if you want this game, you'll pretty much have to download the 3rd party patch for the resolution bug. It's pretty despicable that a primarily cosmetic DLC was put out before a patch was developed. It doesn't really seem like they'll ever fix it for some reason.

Also "Anti-Aliasing" is MSAA, not standard AA. Do not set it to higher than 2x unless you have an absolutely killer video card. I left mine at 2x with a GTX 1070 and got between 55 and 60 fps pretty consistently (minus cutscenes, which play at 30 fps for some reason).

Despite that, I would still recommend it. It took me 35 hours to complete the main story components along with the majority of side-quests, so the amount of entertainment is pretty impressive. The storyline was a roller coaster of emotion with no mercy.

It is also worth noting that the music is phenominal. It was not an after-thought or secondary element like most games. The music is dynamic and deepens the awe and emotions of the story elements and world locations. It's also probably the only game I've played that actually had lyrics in it (sometimes). Most were in "chaos language", which I actually found quite nice.

Make sure you finish endings A-E... you haven't really beaten the game until you do so.

Ultimately, I'm recommending it because I do not regret my purchase. If they just fixed the resolution bug, the reviews probably wouldn't be so conflicted.
